architecture.mechanism: Continuous monitoring of pressure variation exceeding a threshold of 2 standard deviations above baseline pressure.
architecture.intervention: Integrate a high-frequency pressure sensor into the retrofit module to calculate real-time pressure standard deviation and trigger an alarm when variation exceeds 2 SD above the established baseline, replacing static threshold logic.
architecture.expected_effect: Detection of downstream occlusions at least ten minutes prior to conventional alarms by identifying pressure trend anomalies before absolute pressure limits are reached, while minimizing false alarms caused by transient spikes that do not sustain elevated variance.
architecture.falsification_test: If the retrofit fails to alarm within ten minutes of induced occlusion at flow rates between 1 ml/h and 32 ml/h during bench testing despite pressure variance exceeding 2 SD, or if it triggers alarms during normal operation with variance below 2 SD, the mechanism is invalid for this application.
